text: Ok I've been sitting on hold and then waiting on a callback for well over an hour now so I'm just going to type it all out and hopefully someone actually reads it. My son is 7. He's had a temperature on and off since yesterday arvo. I've been giving him Panadol and then Nurofen in between, and honestly between doses he's pretty much his normal self, running around, playing his games, drinking heaps, talking my ear off. So I don't think it's anything too serious with that part, but I'm not a doctor, so. The other thing is he hasn't done a poo in three days which I reckon might be part of it? He's really grumpy about it, keeps going to the toilet, nothing happens, and he comes out cranky. I've been trying to get more water and fruit into him but no luck so far. I guess I just want to know if I should be doing something about the poo situation, like is there something I can give him, or do I just keep waiting it out. And whether the temp is something I need to get looked at or if I just keep going with what I'm doing. I'd really appreciate an actual answer this time, not another 'someone will call you back' message, cheers.
